response = b'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nServer: Apache\r\nContent-Type: image/jpeg\r\n\r\nFAKEDATA99'
pos = response.find(b'\r\n\r\n')
head = response[:pos].decode()
body = response[pos + 4:]
print('pos: %d' % pos)
print('type: %s' % head.split('\r\n')[2].split(': ')[1])
print('bytes: %d' % len(body))
print(body.decode())
